title: Is Mall World really just a large airport or train station instead?

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World may be more like an airport/train station (travel hub) than a mall; cites end-of-life travel-dream reports and cultural journey motifs.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person Mall World dream narrative; mostly speculative/theoretical discussion with a brief waking-life anecdote.

meta.author_theory: Mall World may be an airport/train station-like transit hub; travel dreams may occur near end of life.

extraction.extraction_notes: Contains general descriptive claims about airports/train stations (urgency/chaos/foot traffic; 'suspended in the middle') but not as a dream report with experienced sensory details. Includes external links and a waking-life anecdote about father in hospital asking about traveling to Rome/hotel reservations.
